system.description:
For the duration, you gain a +2 bonus with Charisma based skill checks directed at one creature that isn’t hostile towards you that can hear you within range for the duration.

If used as an Action, this jutsu’s duration becomes Concentration, up to 1 minute. Once Cast in this way, it cannot be cast again as an Action for 10 minutes.

If used as a Reaction, this jutsu’s duration becomes 1 round and lasts until the end of your next turn and cannot be cast in this way again for 1 minute.

If a creature succeeds any contested skill check or beats any Saving throws forced upon them as a result of a social encounter you are engaged in with them by 5 or more, then when the jutsu ends they realize that you used a jutsu to influence its mood if it doesn’t fit your previous relationship.

At Higher Levels: This Jutsu's skill reinforcement increases as you increase in level. The bonus this jutsu provides increases by +1 at 5th Level (+3), 11th level (+4), 17th level (+5)

trigger.text: 1 Action or 1 Reaction, which you take when you fail a Charisma based skill check.
